lines.text: Every year His parents went to Jerusalem for the Feast of the Passover, and when Jesus was twelve they went again.
The boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, and His parents traveled on for a day before they looked among their priests and Levites.
After seven days they found Jesus in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening and asking questions.
His mother said they had searched anxiously, and Jesus said He had to be in His Father's house, but they did not understand.
Jesus went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient, and He grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.
